caption: Day 1, minute 1. The officer decides to tell the truth.
Sol is a killer. Nobody at the table knows that.
The killer claims the same badge, 11 seconds later.
The liar asks the better question.
The mayor votes. That vote counts double.
5 to 1. The town votes out its own officer.
Terra was the officer. Too late.
Night 2. The killers whisper. The town never hears this.
The mayor is gone. The card stays face down.
The other killer, all game long.
Three ties. Nobody leaves. The doctor is protecting a killer and does not know it.
Two killers, one doctor left. Over.
Haiku and Terra called it. Nobody listened.
